name: scopewright
description: Plumbline Labs Scopewright: PCI DSS scoping diagrams with server-derived zone membership and boundary crossings.

scripts.bundle: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/public/assets/app.js && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/. dist/public/
